question: In evidence.zip, Use all d20-- members in ZIP central-directory order. Find the final RS20 overlay. Read k1 at +5, packed length u32le at +8, the 32-byte unpacked SHA-256 at +12, and packed bytes at +44. For each packed byte compute byte XOR k1; then PackBits-decode the result (n<128: copy n+1 literal bytes; n>128: repeat the next byte 257-n times), verify the unpacked SHA-256 and use the HCFG record at unpacked offset 0. Locate the unique CRC32-valid HCFG record: bytes 0..3 are ASCII HCFG, byte 4 is version, byte 5 is the XOR key, bytes 6..7 are the little-endian payload length, bytes 8..11 are the little-endian CRC32 of the decoded payload, and the payload begins at byte 12. XOR every payload byte with the one-byte key, verify CRC32, then parse the decoded UTF-8 JSON.
note: SHA-256 field belongs to another record
